shared_elements: upright rectangular slab/pillar form set in the ground
justification:
Surface B carries a dense carved programme 
tiered rows of arch/H-shaped signs, a horizontal band of chevron and hanging triangle ornament, and several profile creatures (a long-necked bird, quadrupeds, a snake-like form) arranged in registers, whereas surface A shows an eroded, essentially undecorated stone face with no identifiable figures, signs or patterned bands. The only correspondence is the generic presence of an upright rectangular monolithic slab, which is a matter of form rather than depicted subject matter, so no shared iconography can be claimed.
